summary: Incomplete stream termination and partial choices after LB idle-probe connection flip
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that long-running SSE streams terminate without a closing 'end' event after a short network idle period. The client reconnects and receives partial final choices plus duplicated metadata headers, but the stream lacks the final JSON terminator and terminal metadata.

Impact:
- TypeFab production traffic (dedicated tenant) experiences missing final paragraphs for ~3% of streamed completions during peak hours.
- User-facing behavior: truncated last sentence or missing closing punctuation and no final 'done' metadata, causing client SDK to treat stream as still-open and retry, resulting in duplicated tokens.

Environment:
- Dedicated tenant on prod-us-west behind our edge proxy and customer ALB. Affected requests routed through api-gateway -> edge-proxy -> serving-runtime.
- Observed with both redwood-gen-7b and openchat-13b model variants.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Start a long streaming generation (avg length > 120 tokens) from TypeFab web app.
2) Leave tab idle for ~30s (to trigger upstream ALB idle-probe and potential connection reuse).
3) Intermittently (approx 1/50 attempts), the stream ends without emitting the final 'end' sentinel. Client reconnects; on resume receives last fragment with duplicated header block and truncated JSON object.

Observed behavior:
- Final SSE chunks missing terminal metadata ("event: done" / closing choice object).
- Reconnect shows duplicate meta headers, e.g., two 'x-rw-stream-id' fragments and a trailing partial JSON: "... \"text\": \"...final senten\""
- Support logs show short upstream FIN from ALB immediately before the incomplete termination.

Expected behavior:
- Stream should always emit a well-formed terminal event (end/done) and a complete final JSON choice. Reconnect/resume should either replay the final chunk idempotently or resume from a consistent offset.

Logs / artifacts attached (pasted inline):
- edge-proxy logs (excerpt):
  [2026-03-10T14:22:34Z] conn=0x7f4a idle-probe: ALB FIN observed, proxied to upstream=10.12.4.9:443
  [2026-03-10T14:22:34Z] stream_write: wrote partial chunk len=246 status=200 code=OK
  [2026-03-10T14:22:34Z] upstream_close: half-closed upstream; no terminal event flushed to client

- client sdk capture (TypeFab):
  event: data
  id: 9c8b
  data: {"choice":{"index":0,"text":"...the system will continue to"}
  /* connection lost */
  // on resume
  event: meta
  data: {"x-rw-stream-id":"9c8b","x-rw-resume-offset":246}
  event: data
  data: {"choice":{"index":0,"text":"...final senten"}

Temporary workaround applied by support:
- Switched routing for affected customer to bypass a class of ALB probes (rolled to a different edge pool) which reduced occurrence rate to ~0.1% for 24h window.

Request / desired outcome:
- Root cause analysis of how ALB FIN sequence leads to missing terminal event and why reconnect produces duplicated metadata + truncated JSON.
- Fix options: ensure upstream flush of terminal event on half-close, make resume idempotent at the server-side, or detect upstream FIN and synthesize terminal event before closing client stream.

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis A: ALB idle-probe writes an out-of-band FIN that causes edge-proxy to close upstream connection mid-flush.
- Hypothesis B: Edge-proxy's write buffer coalesces metadata and payload; on upstream close we attempt to flush but don't mark terminal event boundary, so client sees partial object.
- Repro harness: sse-stress repro created hitting the same flow with artificially injected FIN at 30s; reproduced truncation deterministically in lab when FIN injected during last-chunk write.

Next steps:
1) SRE to instrument proxy flush path to guarantee terminal-event flush ordering and to add metrics for upstream FIN during terminal-chunk windows. (Assigned INT ticket.)
2) Runtime team to add defensive reassembly on resume: validate JSON object completeness and request retransmit or synthesize terminal metadata if safe.
3) Coordinate with TypeFab to collect request ids for occurrences; add sampling for full tcp dumps for failing attempts.
4) Consider edge policy change to avoid ALB probe reuse in dedicated edge pool for affected customers.
comments: 2026-03-10T15:00Z - Maya Chen (Support): Acknowledged customer report, obtained SDK capture and edge-proxy logs. Escalated to SRE and Runtime. Added temporary bypass routing for affected tenant.

2026-03-10T18:30Z - SRE (Aisha Rao): Reproduced truncation locally using injected FIN at last-chunk write. Evidence points to write ordering race in proxy flush path. Opening INT-4128 for instrumentation.

2026-03-11T09:12Z - Runtime (Diego Morales): Implemented a lab patch that detects incomplete JSON on resume and requests a short retransmit window; reduces duplication but needs validation for idempotency.
2026-03-11T13:05Z - TypeFab (Customer): Confirmed temporary bypass reduced occurrence. Requests ETA for permanent fix; reported business impact on editor autosave features.
2026-03-12T10:20Z - Liam O'Rourke (Assignee): Coordinating upstream PR and rolling canary of proxy flush fix in us-west-edge pool. INT-4128 linked for follow-up.
resolution_notes: Mitigation: temporary bypass to alternate edge pool lowered error rate. Long-term: proxy flush ordering fix in review (PR 893). Runtime defensive resume added in lab; will be A/B tested. Owner: SRE+Runtime cross-team. Target full rollout: 2026-03-20.
